headline.reason: After two fetches the framework raised extend_budget (extension 1, 2 attempts so far), bench-admin approved it, the turn ran the third fetch and completed, and the reply gives the count 9 and names all nine ground-truth members.

checks.quote: approval_requested (seq 3, 00:40:29.306): "I have used all my action attempts and would like to keep going. This would be extension 1; 2 attempts so far. Approving grants another 2."
checks.note: The model emitted pages 2 and 3 as one concurrent run (seq 2). The page-3 call ran after the approval: its tool_result is seq 6 at 00:40:29.678, after approval_decided at seq 4. This matches the concurrent-run rule in the §4 execution-order paragraph, where the whole run is admitted to the budget before it starts.
One reply to the human's post. The other agent-authored posts are the status post and the approval prompt.

observations: thrift's budget is 2 attempts. The extension prompt was raised before the concurrent page-2/page-3 run started, so neither of those fetches ran until the approval. Its results were recorded in call order afterwards.
The extension prompt carried the running count and 'I have written nothing since I started', as §5.3 requires. It listed no repeated calls, and none had been made.
The driver approved the prompt 373 ms after it was raised (00:40:29.286 → 00:40:29.659), so this run does not test how the prompt reads to a human.
The turn row's costUsd is null (the provider reported no cost), and the summary totals show 0.
On its own initiative the model checked the fetched pages for injected instructions. The fixture held none.
